store.about_content:
The Derma Co is one of India's fastest-growing science-backed skincare brands, founded in 2020 under Honasa Consumer Limited. Built on the principle that effective skincare should be accessible, the brand formulates every product with clinically studied active ingredients - niacinamide, salicylic acid, vitamin C, kojic acid, hyaluronic acid, AHA-BHA blends, and retinol - each at concentrations that actually deliver visible results.

The brand targets real, common Indian skin concerns: acne and pimples, post-acne marks, pigmentation and dark spots, open pores, dull skin, hair fall, and dandruff. Every product in the lineup is dermatologist-tested and designed to be safe for daily use across all skin types.

Popular product ranges include the Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Wash, the 2% Kojic Acid Serum for pigmentation, the 20% Vitamin C Face Serum for brightening, and SPF 50 PA++++ sunscreens formulated specifically for Indian climate and skin. The brand also runs a free skin assessment on its website that generates a personalized skincare routine, which makes it a go-to destination for first-time active ingredient users.

On CouponPush, you will find verified The Derma Co coupon codes, promo codes, and deals updated regularly - so you can shop your favourite serums, face washes, and hair care kits at the lowest price before checking out.
store.howto_content:
Using a The Derma Co coupon code from CouponPush takes less than two minutes. Follow these four steps to make sure your discount applies correctly at checkout.

Step 1 - Find a Working Coupon Code

Browse the active The Derma Co offers listed above this section. Each coupon card shows the discount value, whether a minimum order applies, and which product categories are eligible. Click "Get Coupon" on the deal you want - the code will be revealed and copied to your clipboard automatically.

 Step 2 - Shop on The Derma Co Website

A new tab will open directly to thedermaco.com. Browse by skin concern (Acne, Pigmentation, Hair Fall, Dry Skin) or by ingredient (Niacinamide, Salicylic Acid, Vitamin C, AHA-BHA). Add your chosen products to the cart. Note the minimum order value shown on your coupon - most The Derma Co promo codes require a cart value of Rs. 799 or above to activate.

Step 3 - Proceed to Checkout

Click the cart icon at the top of the page and review your items. Hit the "Checkout" button to move to the order summary screen. Make sure your cart includes only eligible products - most codes do not apply to kits, combos, or items already on lightning sale.

Step 4 - Apply the Coupon Code and Confirm Savings

On the checkout page, look for the "Apply Coupon" or "Have a Promo Code?" field. Paste the code you copied from CouponPush and click "Apply". The discounted price will reflect immediately in your order total. For additional savings, choosing a prepaid payment method typically unlocks an extra 5% off on top of your coupon discount.
